# do_BarPlot() | Categorical proportions

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Bar plots visualize the proportions of categorical variables across groups.

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_BarPlot(sample = sample,
                        group.by = "seurat_clusters",
                        split.by = "condition")
p
```
